title: Raw presheaf colimit evaluation at a represented object
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$, and $H=V_{i,s}G$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. For $t\in I$ let $B_t$ be a presheaf on $C$, with $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$ exhibiting $B_t$ as the left Kan extension of the underlying presheaf of $A_t$ along $V_t^{op}$. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$, $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction, and a left Kan extension means that composition with $\beta_t$ bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every presheaf $T$. Let $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$ have these objects and satisfy, for all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Set})$.Assume the object and arrow cocones of $V$ are set colimits [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor]. Fix $U\in F(i)$ and a set diagram $D:I\to\mathrm{Set}$ with isomorphisms $E_t:D(t)\cong A_t(F(t.hom)U)$. Suppose $E_t\theta_b= D(b)E_{t'}$ as arrow objects. Let $T$ be any presheaf on $C$, $\gamma:B\to\mathrm{const}(T)$ natural, and $a_t:A_t\to V_t^pT$ with $\beta_t(X)\gamma_t(V_tX)=a_t(X)$. There exist a colimit cocone $R$ of $D$ and an isomorphism $q:R.pt\cong(\mathrm{colim}\,B)(V_iU)$ such that $R_tq(\mathrm{colim.desc}\,\gamma)(V_iU)=E_t a_t(F(t.hom)U)$ as arrow objects for each $t$. Neither $T$ nor $\mathrm{colim}\,B$ is assumed to be a sheaf.

proof.text: The pointwise Kan formula presents evaluation of B_t at V_iU by a section at W and an arrow V_iU to V_tW. Lift this arrow and its endpoints to a common stage using the object and arrow colimit hypotheses. Transport the section by theta and restrict along the lifted arrow to get a D representative through E. Every generator of the evaluated raw colimit thereby has a D representative.

proof.text: Lift finitely many Kan relations to a common stage and use eventual arrow equality to identify their lifts. The beta transition equation and the E transition equation identify the resulting D representatives. Hence the canonical maps between colimit D and evaluation of colimit B are inverse. Equivalently the presentations carrying U forward are final by common refinement and equalization. Transport the set-colimit cocone along this isomorphism to obtain R and q.

proof.text: Evaluate colimit.desc gamma on a Kan-unit representative: the result is beta_t followed by gamma_t. Naturality accounts for the object-equality transport, and the equation with a_t gives the asserted Arrow equality.
